shloka_text: लक्ष्मणस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा शत्रुनिबर्हणः । वृत्रघातमशेषेण कथयेत्याह सुव्रत ।। 7.85.1 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā śatrunibarhaṇaḥ | vṛtraghātamaśeṣeṇa kathayetyāha suvrata || 7.85.1 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, शत्रुनिबर्हणः the destroyer of enemies, वृत्रघातम् the slaying of Vritra, अशेषेण completely, कथय narrate, इति thus, आह said, सुव्रत O one of good vows.
explanation: Having heard that speech of Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemies (Rama) said, "O one of good vows, narrate the slaying of Vritra completely."
comments: At Rama's bidding Lakshmana finishes the tale of Vritra -- Vishnu, bound by friendship with the demon, divides himself into three parts, entering Indra, his thunderbolt and the earth, so that Indra may slay him -- the gods march out, Indra beheads Vritra with the thunderbolt, but the sin of brahmin-slaughter pursues and clings to him.

shloka_text: राघवेणैवमुक्तस्तु सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः । भूय एव कथां दिव्यां कथयामास सुव्रतः ।। 7.85.2 ।।
transliteration: rāghaveṇaivamuktastu sumitrānandavardhanaḥ | bhūya eva kathāṃ divyāṃ kathayāmāsa suvrataḥ || 7.85.2 ||
translation: राघवेण by Rama, एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, तु indeed, सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः the enhancer of Sumitra's joy, भूयः again, एव indeed, कथां story, दिव्यां divine, कथयामास narrated, सुव्रतः the one of good vows.
explanation: Thus addressed by Rama, the enhancer of Sumitra's joy, who was of good vows, again narrated the divine story.

shloka_text: सहस्राक्षवचः श्रुत्वा सर्वेषां च दिवौकसाम् । विष्णुर्देवानुवाचेदं सर्वानिन्द्रपुरोगमान् ।। 7.85.3 ।।
transliteration: sahasrākṣavacaḥ śrutvā sarveṣāṃ ca divaukasām | viṣṇurdevānuvācedaṃ sarvānindrapurogamān || 7.85.3 ||
translation: सहस्राक्षवचः Indra's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सर्वेषां of all, च and, दिवौकसाम् of the gods, विष्णुः Vishnu, देवान् to the gods, उवाच said, इदं this, सर्वान् all, इन्द्रपुरोगमान् with Indra as their leader.
explanation: Having heard the words of Indra and all the gods, Vishnu spoke these words to all the gods, with Indra at their forefront.

shloka_text: पूर्वं सौहृदबद्धो ऽस्मि वृत्रस्य ह महात्मनः । तेन युष्मत्प्रियार्थं हि नाहं हन्मि महासुरम् ।। 7.85.4 ।।
transliteration: pūrvaṃ sauhṛdabaddho 'smi vṛtrasya ha mahātmanaḥ | tena yuṣmatpriyārthaṃ hi nāhaṃ hanmi mahāsuram || 7.85.4 ||
translation: पूर्वं previously, सौहृदबद्धः bound by friendship, अस्मि I am, वृत्रस्य of Vritra, ह indeed, महात्मनः the great-souled one, तेन therefore, युष्मत्प्रियार्थं for your benefit, हि indeed, न not, अहं I, हन्मि kill, महासुरम् the great demon.
explanation: I am indeed bound by a prior friendship with the great Vritra, and therefore I cannot kill this great demon for your benefit.

shloka_text: अवश्यं करणीयं च भवतां सुखमुत्तमम् । तस्मादुपायमाख्यास्ये येन वृत्रो निहन्यते ।। 7.85.5 ।।
transliteration: avaśyaṃ karaṇīyaṃ ca bhavatāṃ sukhamuttamam | tasmādupāyamākhyāsye yena vṛtro nihanyate || 7.85.5 ||
translation: अवश्यं certainly, करणीयम् to be done, च and, भवतां your, सुखम् happiness, उत्तमम् supreme, तस्मात् therefore, उपायम् a means, आख्यास्ये I shall explain, येन by which, वृत्रः Vritra, निहन्यते is killed.
explanation: Your supreme happiness must certainly be achieved, therefore I shall explain a method by which Vritra can be killed.

shloka_text: त्रिधाभूतं करिष्यामि ह्यात्मानं सुरसत्तमाः । तेन वृत्रं सहस्राक्षो वधिष्यति न संशयः ।। 7.85.6 ।।
transliteration: tridhābhūtaṃ kariṣyāmi hyātmānaṃ surasattamāḥ | tena vṛtraṃ sahasrākṣo vadhiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 7.85.6 ||
translation: त्रिधाभूतं made into three parts, करिष्यामि I shall make, हि indeed, आत्मानं myself, सुरसत्तमाः O best of gods, तेन thereby, वृत्रं Vritra, सहस्राक्षः Indra, वधिष्यति will kill, न no, संशयः doubt.
explanation: O best of gods, I shall indeed divide myself into three parts, and thereby Indra will kill Vritra without a doubt.

shloka_text: एकांशो वासवं यातु द्वितीयो वज्रमेव तु । तृतीयो भूतलं शक्रस्तदा वृत्रं वधिष्यति ।। 7.85.7 ।।
transliteration: ekāṃśo vāsavaṃ yātu dvitīyo vajrameva tu | tṛtīyo bhūtalaṃ śakrastadā vṛtraṃ vadhiṣyati || 7.85.7 ||
translation: एकांशः one part, वासवं to Indra, यातु let it go, द्वितीयः the second, वज्रम् to the thunderbolt, एव indeed, तु and, तृतीयः the third, भूतलम् to the earth, शक्रः Indra, तदा then, वृत्रं Vritra, वधिष्यति will kill.
explanation: Let one part of me go into Indra, the second into his thunderbolt, and the third into the earth; then Indra will be able to kill Vritra.

shloka_text: तथा ब्रुवति देवेशे देवा वाक्यमथाब्रुवन् । एवमेतन्न सन्देहो यथा वदसि दैत्यहन् ।। 7.85.8 ।।
transliteration: tathā bruvati deveśe devā vākyamathābruvan | evametanna sandeho yathā vadasi daityahan || 7.85.8 ||
translation: तथा thus, ब्रुवति while speaking, देवेशे to the lord of gods (Vishnu), देवाः the gods, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रुवन् spoke, एवम् thus, एतत् this, न not, सन्देहः doubt, यथा as, वदसि you speak, दैत्यहन् O slayer of demons.
explanation: When the Lord of Gods (Vishnu) spoke thus, the gods then replied, "O slayer of demons, what you say is indeed true, there is no doubt about it."

shloka_text: भद्रं ते ऽस्तु गमिष्यामो वृत्रासुरवधैषिणः । भजस्व परमोदार वासवं स्वेन तेजसा ।। 7.85.9 ।।
transliteration: bhadraṃ te 'stu gamiṣyāmo vṛtrāsuravadhaiṣiṇaḥ | bhajasva paramodāra vāsavaṃ svena tejasā || 7.85.9 ||
translation: भद्रम् welfare, ते to you, अस्तु let it be, गमिष्यामः we shall go, वृत्रासुरवधैषिणः desirous of killing Vritrasura, भजस्व resort to, परमोदार O most generous one, वासवम् Indra, स्वेन with your own, तेजसा might.
explanation: "May good fortune be with you; we shall now go, eager to slay Vritrasura, and O most generous one, you should empower Indra with your own might."

shloka_text: ततः सर्वे महात्मानः सहस्राक्षपुरोगमाः । तदारण्यमुपाक्रामन्यत्र वृत्रो महासुरः ।। 7.85.10 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sarve mahātmānaḥ sahasrākṣapurogamāḥ | tadāraṇyamupākrāmanyatra vṛtro mahāsuraḥ || 7.85.10 ||
translation: ततः then, सर्वे all, महात्मानः the great-souled ones, सहस्राक्षपुरोगमाः with Indra at the forefront, तत् that, अरण्यम् forest, उपाक्रामन् approached, यत्र where, वृत्रः Vritra, महासुरः the great demon.
explanation: Then all the great-souled gods, led by Indra, proceeded towards that forest where the mighty demon Vritra resided.

shloka_text: ते पश्यंस्तेजसा भूतं तप्यन्तमसुरोत्तमम् । पिबन्तमिव लोकांस्त्रीन्निर्दहन्तमिवाम्बरम् ।। 7.85.11 ।।
transliteration: te paśyaṃstejasā bhūtaṃ tapyantamasurottamam | pibantamiva lokāṃstrīnnirdahantamivāmbaram || 7.85.11 ||
translation: ते they, पश्यन् saw, तेजसा with splendor, भूतं endowed, तप्यन्तम् radiating heat, असुरोत्तमम् the best of demons, पिबन्तम् drinking, इव as if, लोकान् worlds, त्रीन् three, निर्दहन्तम् burning completely, इव as if, अम्बरम् the sky.
explanation: They saw the foremost of demons, Vritra, endowed with immense splendor and radiating heat, as if he were drinking up the three worlds and burning the very sky.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वैव चासुरश्रेष्ठं देवास्त्रासमुपागमन् । कथमेनं वधिष्यामः कथं न स्यात्पराजयः ।। 7.85.12 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvaiva cāsuraśreṣṭhaṃ devāstrāsamupāgaman | kathamenaṃ vadhiṣyāmaḥ kathaṃ na syātparājayaḥ || 7.85.12 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, एव indeed, च and, असुरश्रेष्ठम् the best of demons, देवाः the gods, त्रासम् fear, उपागमन् felt, कथम् how, एनम् him, वधिष्यामः shall we kill, कथम् how, न not, स्यात् may it be, पराजयः defeat.
explanation: And having seen that foremost of demons, the gods were struck with fear, wondering, "How shall we kill him? How can we avoid defeat?"

shloka_text: तेषां चिन्तयतां तत्र सहस्राक्षः पुरन्दरः । वज्रं प्रगृह्य पाणिभ्यां प्राहिणोद्वृत्रमूर्धनि ।। 7.85.13 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ cintayatāṃ tatra sahasrākṣaḥ purandaraḥ | vajraṃ pragṛhya pāṇibhyāṃ prāhiṇodvṛtramūrdhani || 7.85.13 ||
translation: तेषां of them, चिन्तयतां while thinking, तत्र there, सहस्राक्षः the thousand-eyed (Indra), पुरन्दरः the destroyer of cities (Indra), वज्रं the thunderbolt, प्रगृह्य having grasped, पाणिभ्यां with both hands, प्राहिणोत् he hurled, वृत्रमूर्धनि on Vritra's head.
explanation: While the gods were contemplating there, the thousand-eyed Indra, the destroyer of cities, grasped the thunderbolt with both hands and hurled it onto Vritra's head.

shloka_text: कालाग्निनेव घोरेण तप्तेनैव महार्चिषा । पतता वृत्रशिरसा जगत्ऺत्रासमुपागमत् ।। 7.85.14 ।।
transliteration: kālāgnineva ghoreṇa taptenaiva mahārciṣā | patatā vṛtraśirasā jagatऺtrāsamupāgamat || 7.85.14 ||
translation: कालाग्निना by the fire of time, इव as if, घोरेण terrible, तप्तेन burning, एव indeed, महार्चिषा with a great flame, पतता falling, वृत्रशिरसा by Vritra's head, जगत् the world, त्रासं terror, उपागमत् experienced.
explanation: As Vritra's head fell, burning like the terrible, great-flamed fire of universal destruction, the world experienced immense terror.

shloka_text: असम्भाव्यं वधं तस्य वृत्रस्य विबुधाधिपः । चिन्तयानो जगामाशु लोकस्यान्तं महायशाः ।। 7.85.15 ।।
transliteration: asambhāvyaṃ vadhaṃ tasya vṛtrasya vibudhādhipaḥ | cintayāno jagāmāśu lokasyāntaṃ mahāyaśāḥ || 7.85.15 ||
translation: असम्भाव्यं the inconceivable, वधं killing, तस्य of him, वृत्रस्य of Vritra, विबुधाधिपः the lord of gods, चिन्तयानः contemplating, जगाम he went, आशु quickly, लोकस्य of the world, अन्तं to the end, महायशाः the greatly renowned.
explanation: The greatly renowned lord of gods, contemplating the inconceivable slaying of Vritra, quickly went to a secluded corner of the world.

shloka_text: तमिन्द्रं ब्रह्महत्या ऽ ऽशु गच्छन्तमनुगच्छति । अपतच्चास्य गात्रेषु तमिन्द्रं दुःखमाविशत् ।। 7.85.16 ।।
transliteration: tamindraṃ brahmahatyā ' 'śu gacchantamanugacchati | apataccāsya gātreṣu tamindraṃ duḥkhamāviśat || 7.85.16 ||
translation: तं that, इन्द्रं Indra, ब्रह्महत्या the sin of Brahmanicide, आशु quickly, गच्छन्तं going, अनुगच्छति followed, अपतत् it fell, च and, अस्य his, गात्रेषु on limbs, तं that, इन्द्रं Indra, दुःखं sorrow, आविशत् enveloped.
explanation: As that Indra was going, the sin of Brahmanicide quickly followed him and fell upon his limbs, enveloping him in sorrow.

shloka_text: हतारयः प्रनष्टेन्द्रा देवाः साग्निपुरोगमाः । विष्णुं त्रिभुवनेशानं मुहुर्मुहुरपूजयन् ।। 7.85.17 ।।
transliteration: hatārayaḥ pranaṣṭendrā devāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ | viṣṇuṃ tribhuvaneśānaṃ muhurmuhurapūjayan || 7.85.17 ||
translation: हतारयः whose enemies were slain, प्रनष्टेन्द्राः whose Indra was lost, देवाः the gods, साग्निपुरोगमाः with Agni as their leader, विष्णुं Vishnu, त्रिभुवनेशानं the lord of the three worlds, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, अपूजयन् they worshipped.
explanation: The gods, whose enemies were slain but whose Indra had disappeared, with Agni as their leader, repeatedly worshipped Vishnu, the lord of the three worlds.

shloka_text: त्वं गतिः परमेशान पूर्वजो जगतः पिता । रक्षार्थं सर्वभूतानां विष्णुत्वमुपजग्मिवान् ।। 7.85.18 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ gatiḥ parameśāna pūrvajo jagataḥ pitā | rakṣārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viṣṇutvamupajagmivān || 7.85.18 ||
translation: त्वं You, गतिः the refuge, परमेशान O Supreme Lord, पूर्वजः the primeval one, जगतः of the world, पिता the father, रक्षार्थं for the protection, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, विष्णुत्वम् the state of Vishnu, उपजग्मिवान् you have attained.
explanation: O Supreme Lord, you are the ultimate refuge, the primeval father of the world, who has assumed the form of Vishnu for the protection of all beings.

shloka_text: हतश्चायं त्वया वृत्रो ब्रह्महत्या च वासवम् । बाधते सुरशार्दूल मोक्षं तस्या विनिर्दिश ।। 7.85.19 ।।
transliteration: hataścāyaṃ tvayā vṛtro brahmahatyā ca vāsavam | bādhate suraśārdūla mokṣaṃ tasyā vinirdiśa || 7.85.19 ||
translation: हतः killed, च and, अयं this, त्वया by you, वृत्रः Vritra, ब्रह्महत्या the sin of Brahmanicide, च and, वासवम् Indra, बाधते afflicts, सुरशार्दूल O best among gods, मोक्षं liberation, तस्या from that, विनिर्दिश please prescribe.
explanation: O best among gods, Vritra has been killed by you, and now the sin of Brahmanicide afflicts Indra; please prescribe a means of liberation for him from this sin.

shloka_text: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवानां विष्णुरब्रवीत् । मामेव यजतां शक्रः पावयिष्यामि वज्रिणम् ।। 7.85.20 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devānāṃ viṣṇurabravīt | māmeva yajatāṃ śakraḥ pāvayiṣyāmi vajriṇam || 7.85.20 ||
translation: तेषां their, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, देवानां of the gods, विष्णुः Vishnu, अब्रवीत् said, माम् me, एव only, यजतां let him worship, शक्रः Indra, पावयिष्यामि I shall purify, वज्रिणम् the wielder of the thunderbolt.
explanation: Having heard the words of the gods, Vishnu said, "Let Indra worship me alone, and I shall purify the wielder of the thunderbolt."

shloka_text: पुण्येन हयमेधेन मामिष्ट्वा पाकशासनः । पुनरेष्यति देवानामिन्द्रत्वमकुतोभयम् ।। 7.85.21 ।।
transliteration: puṇyena hayamedhena māmiṣṭvā pākaśāsanaḥ | punareṣyati devānāmindratvamakutobhayam || 7.85.21 ||
translation: पुण्येन by the sacred, हयमेधेन Ashvamedha sacrifice, माम् me, इष्ट्वा having worshipped, पाकशासनः Indra, पुनः again, एष्यति he will attain, देवानाम् of the gods, इन्द्रत्वम् the sovereignty of Indra, अकुतोभयम् fearless.
explanation: Having worshipped me with a meritorious Ashvamedha sacrifice, Indra will again attain his fearless sovereignty over the gods.

shloka_text: एवं सन्दिश्य तां वाणीं देवानाममृतोपमाम् । जगाम विष्णुर्देवेशः स्तूयमानस्त्रिविष्टपम् ।। 7.85.22 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sandiśya tāṃ vāṇīṃ devānāmamṛtopamām | jagāma viṣṇurdeveśaḥ stūyamānastriviṣṭapam || 7.85.22 ||
translation: एवं thus, सन्दिश्य having instructed, तां that, वाणीं speech, देवानाम् of the gods, अमृतोपमाम् nectar-like, जगाम went, विष्णुः Vishnu, देवेशः the lord of gods, स्तूयमानः being praised, त्रिविष्टपम् to heaven.
explanation: Having thus delivered that nectar-like message to the gods, Vishnu, the lord of gods, returned to heaven, being praised by them. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चाशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 85 ।। Thus ends the eighty-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
